english.note: Use 最 before an adjective or adjective phrase to form the superlative, as in 最重要嘅.
Use this before a gradable verb or adjective when “furthest” means to the greatest degree, as in 發展得最先進.
Use 最 before a description when firmly asserting the superlative, as in “the very best.”

examples.english: This is the tea I like most.

examples.english: Of the proposals, this one is the furthest developed.
